query:
DELETE FROM git_sync_ci_test_check c
         WHERE c.concluded AND c.github_posted
           AND c.concluded_at < now() - make_interval(secs => $1)
           AND NOT EXISTS (
               SELECT 1 FROM git_sync_synced_head h
               WHERE h.workspace_id = c.workspace_id
                 AND h.repo_resource_path = c.repo_resource_path
                 AND h.sha = c.head_sha
           )
